annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 1797/2024 - Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 - General rules for the responsible development, implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 1797/2024 sets general rules for responsible AI development and use to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory uses, biometric categorisation and manipulative techniques, imposes strict liability on providers, gives rights to contest decisions, empowers the ANPD for risk classification, and creates a National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bans AI uses that discriminate, biometric categorisation inferring race, beliefs or orientation, and subliminal or manipulative techniques
Strict liability of AI providers or operators for property or moral damage regardless of system autonomy
Right to contest and request review of significant AI decisions and correct data
Amends LGPD so the ANPD regulates, sanctions, supervises and classifies AI risk levels
Creates the interministerial National Council on AI (CNIA) as an advisory body
